description: This file appears to be a core source code file for Git's revision traversal and revision list management. It includes definitions for rev-list functionalities, commit filtering, object management, revision selection, and related data structures and algorithms.

classes.name: commit_stack
classes.description: A stack data structure for managing commits during traversal. Used in marking parent commits uninteresting.

classes.name: treesame_state
classes.description: Data structure for maintaining treesame (a concept related to common ancestors) status in commit merge simplifications.

classes.name: exclude_hidden_refs_cb
classes.description: Callback structure used when handling config for hiding refs.

classes.name: all_refs_cb
classes.description: Callback context for processing all refs and reflogs during traversal and updates.

methods.description: Marks a tree object as uninteresting, including its contents.
